verdict.rationale: The repo maintains a first-party RELEASE-NOTES.md with detailed, skill-level change descriptions, so a developer can see what changed in the skills before updating. Examples include worktree removal no longer destroying untracked files, plan-scoped sdd-workspace, the review-fix loop resuming the implementer, testing-anti-patterns.md renamed to writing-good-tests.md, and new harness support. missing for 10: evidence tying notes to specific version numbers/dates or tagged releases, a link from the update path (e.g. 'reinstall to update') to the notes, and independent corroboration that users rely on the notes before updating.
